name: manual_e27675
claim: git branch -f <name> <sha> refuses to move the currently checked-out branch (exits non-zero; the ref is unchanged). Use git update-ref refs/heads/<name> <sha> to move only the ref while staying on the branch; then synchronize index and working tree afterward (for example git restore --staged --worktree .) so staged/worktree state does not still reflect the undone cherry-pick.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit PR #332 review 4870664281: git branch -f rejects moving the checked-out branch (exit 128, ref unchanged); git update-ref moves only the ref and index/worktree need explicit restore after rollback.
